confirmed: The local source is arXiv:2501.18588v1 dated 30 Jan 2025, with 18 PDF pages; the title and author list match the form (PDF p. 1, title block and arXiv stamp; last PDF page is p. 18).

The complete markdown, including references and final back matter, was read. Figures 13 and 14 and Table 1 are in the PDF after the references; no separately designated appendix or supplement is stated (PDF pp. 17-18).

The main study is a within-person comparison of Inkspire and baseline ControlNet, both generative-AI configurations; each participant used both tools (PDF p. 7, Section 5; PDF p. 8, Section 5.3.2; PDF p. 18, Figure 14).

The paper explicitly counterbalances tool and task order but does not state random allocation to sequences. randomized=not_stated, n_randomized=null, design_class=other, and criterion_1=unclear are supported; no confirmed randomized people study with a qualifying scored creative-output outcome was found (PDF p. 8, Section 5.3.2; PDF pp. 7-11, Sections 5-6).

The main analysis uses 12 people, the same people in both conditions, comprising six professional designers and six novices; the participant paragraph reports 10 male and 2 female participants. This is fewer than 50 people, and the two condition counts must not be added as separate samples (PDF p. 7, Section 5.1; PDF p. 8, paired t-tests in Section 6.1; PDF p. 14, Section 7.1; PDF p. 18, Table 1 lists P1-P12).

The separate formative exchange involved seven professional product designers at a large automotive company, with no assigned comparison or scored creative-output outcome described (PDF p. 4, Section 3).

Participants designed a lamp themed around serenity and a chair themed around fluidity, one task per tool. The design-task phase is labeled 45 minutes within the one-hour study (PDF p. 7, Section 5.1; PDF p. 8, Section 5.3.2).

Inkspire uses GPT-4 for analogical inspirations and ControlNet-guided Stable Diffusion for sketch-driven image generation, with sketch scaffolding; the baseline omits analogical inspirations, scaffold underlays, and stroke-by-stroke generation (PDF p. 5, Section 4.2; PDF pp. 6-7, Sections 4.2-4.3; PDF p. 18, Figure 14).

Creativity Support Index measures and final design quality were participant questionnaire ratings on a 7-point Likert scale, compared with paired t-tests; final design quality was rated by the creators themselves (PDF p. 8, Section 5.2; PDF p. 11, Section 6.3).

All numerical values in the exploration and inspiration reported strings match the PDF, including means, SDs, t statistics, degrees of freedom, p thresholds, r, and d_s; only their mean/SD labels are corrupted (PDF p. 8, Section 6.1; PDF p. 9, Figure 5).

All numerical values in the final-design-quality reported string match the PDF, and p=0.06 is correctly described as not statistically significant (PDF p. 11, Section 6.3; PDF p. 13, Figure 11, left).

BERTScore is calculated between user prompts, while the discussion of diversity in completed designs is qualitative. Interaction logs and analogy-category counts do not establish a scored creativity/diversity comparison on the produced designs (PDF p. 9, Section 6.2.2; PDF pp. 10-11, Sections 6.2.4-6.3; PDF pp. 17-18, Figure 13 and Table 1).

core=no, criterion_2=not_met, criterion_3=not_met, and context_class=none remain supported under the codebook: the small sample and participant self-ratings do not qualify, and no AI-versus-human-output comparison or eligible observational context comparison is reported (PDF pp. 7-11, Sections 5-6; PDF p. 14, Section 7.1; creativity-codebook.md, Section 3).
This is an original system/user-study paper rather than a synthesis; no pooled study count, estimate, interval, or standardizer needs extraction (PDF p. 4, Section 3; PDF pp. 7-14, Sections 5-8).
summary: Core exclusion is supported: the study analyzed 12 people, random assignment is unstated, and creativity-support and final-design-quality ratings are self-reports. All recorded numerical values and the source version match the PDF, but Toyota Research Institute involvement and corrupted mean/SD labels require correction.
